zh.title: Malaysia Aviation Group 簽約收購 Airbus 旗下 Sepang Aircraft Engineering
zh.summary: 交易仍待包括馬來西亞民航局在內的主管機關核准，雙方以 2027 年完成為目標，未公布交易金額。
body: Malaysia Aviation Group（MAG）與 Airbus 已簽署股份買賣協議，MAG 將收購 Airbus 全資持有的 Sepang Aircraft Engineering（SAE）。交易仍須符合成交條件並取得主管機關核准，包括馬來西亞民航局的批准。
MAG 將這項收購列為 Long-Term Business Plan 3.0 的一部分，雙方以 2027 年完成交易為目標。公開資訊未揭露交易金額。
SAE 位於吉隆坡國際機場（KUL），具備 Airbus A320 系列維修能力，並設有專用噴漆棚與零組件維修設施。MAG 表示，將把這些能力納入集團的工程與維修布局。

en.title: Malaysia Aviation Group signs deal to acquire Airbus-owned Sepang Aircraft Engineering
en.summary: The transaction remains subject to approvals including from Malaysia's civil aviation regulator, with completion targeted for 2027; no price was disclosed.
body: Malaysia Aviation Group and Airbus have signed a share purchase agreement under which MAG will acquire Airbus-owned Sepang Aircraft Engineering. Closing remains subject to conditions and regulatory approvals, including clearance from the Civil Aviation Authority of Malaysia.
MAG describes the acquisition as part of its Long-Term Business Plan 3.0, and the parties are targeting completion in 2027. The value of the transaction has not been disclosed.

Located at Kuala Lumpur International Airport (KUL), SAE has Airbus A320-family maintenance expertise as well as a dedicated paint hangar and component-repair facilities. MAG says those capabilities will be integrated into its engineering and maintenance strategy.

facts.claim: Malaysia Aviation Group signed a share purchase agreement to acquire Airbus-owned Sepang Aircraft Engineering.
The transaction is subject to regulatory approvals, including from the Civil Aviation Authority of Malaysia, and is targeted to close in 2027.
